_: LIVE-GATE-1: the assertions of the signed-in production DOM gate (scripts/ci/live/dom-gate.mjs). armed true means a failure is red; armed false is printed as NOT-ARMED with what the run saw. The owner lane arms its assertion in the PR that merges its fix, after seeing it pass on production. A ratchet: once armed, never disarmed (tests/ci/live-gate.test.mjs ARMED_FLOOR pins it; a lane that arms one adds it there).

assertions.rule: each of the five list pages ends off /login and draws the account menu
every detail link on the five lists answers a non-404 page that is not the sign-in page
no uuid, no '. 0.xx' score, no pattern_ method id and no _gap token in the text a reader sees on the five lists and their first details
every list row on the five lists draws a non-empty second line
every connection entry on a first detail renders a sentence of at least three words, not a token
the pending-synthesis and stale-synthesis notices are absent from the five lists and their first details
on a first detail, the pending-triggers panel is absent or every trigger text contains the item's instrument number
the profile opened from the United States column of the operations matrix names none of the forbidden other-region entities

on /market the ribbon's 'N families from M series' line is read, N equals the cards drawn, the series behind the cards cover every series the series board holds with a latest value, and M equals the board's series count
the dashboard draws an element marked data-audit=flywheel-radar holding at least one link or an absence statement
